About
About Los Nopalitos

Los Nopalitos, located at 4723 W 34th St in Houston, TX, is a modest yet highly regarded Mexican restaurant that has earned a reputation for its authentic cuisine and friendly service. Despite its unassuming exterior, this hidden gem delivers an exceptional dining experience. Known for its delicious, traditional Mexican dishes, the restaurant specializes in breakfast options, with many visitors raving about the flavorful chorizo con huevo platter. The chorizo, perfectly seasoned and paired with fresh tortillas, stands out as a crowd favorite.

While the décor and overall atmosphere may be simple, the food and service more than make up for it. The restaurant’s staff is consistently praised for being warm and welcoming, with attentive service that ensures guests have everything they need throughout their meal. Whether it's checking in on drink refills or ensuring extra tortillas are brought to the table, the staff goes above and beyond to create a comfortable dining environment. Prices are fair, making it an excellent option for those seeking a satisfying meal without breaking the bank.

Another highlight of Los Nopalitos is the variety of salsas, with guests particularly enjoying the red sauce, which is frequently rated as a perfect complement to the meals. Although some visitors have mentioned a preference for the more traditional chopped potatoes instead of the french fries served with certain platters, this minor detail does not detract from the overall quality of the food.

Overall, Los Nopalitos delivers authentic Mexican food at a great price, combined with excellent service, making it a worthwhile stop for those looking to indulge in classic flavors.

Reviews

“ The food is great, service is great and it’s a warm, cozy place. ”

Gerardo Lopez

“ This is my initial visit to this modest Mexican restaurant. Despite its humble appearance, the cuisine was exceptionally gratifying. As a connoisseur of authentic Mexican cuisine, particularly breakfast dishes, I must express my satisfaction. I selected the chorizo con huevo platter, which was expertly prepared and accompanied by delectable tortillas. The service was impeccable. I was warmly welcomed upon entering the establishment, and my drink order was promptly taken as I was seated. Throughout the meal, my attentive waitress visited my table on three occasions to inquire if I required anything further, such as additional beverages or tortillas. I shall undoubtedly revisit this restaurant in the future. The only minor issue I encountered was the presence of french fries instead of the customary chopped potatoes that typically accompany breakfast platters. ”

ANGELO

“ This little whole in the wall has some tasty authentic mexican food the place is not all that but the food and the service was amazing and their prices are fair.. ”

Xiovan Singh

“ Great little place with well seasoned Mexican food. Fast friendly service and good portions for the Very Reasonable prices ”

Charles Conti

“ Food was great! I did not care for the green sauce but the red sauce was a 10. ”

Armentha Williams

Antonio Helm
